mostWorthwhile.text: Developing distinct island songs was most worthwhile: it distinguished inherited variation from learned traditions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The mountain crossing was predictable and offered little detail beyond birds reaching feeding and breeding grounds.

surprise.text: Birdsong differences can reflect learned traditions as well as inherited variation.

arbitrary.text: Combining distinct songs with a food web felt somewhat indirect: songs identify the birds, but do not themselves explain how the web supports them.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the concise explanations of island formation and birdsong made familiar combinations informative, though most choices were forced.
